_comment: How a GDScript file names a path it mentions: written (only writes it, so it can recreate it) or used. Checked by src/tools/reference_kind.rs (cargo test) and the_addon_classifies_script_references_like_the_server (editor_e2e_test).

cases.name: a generator saves to a constant and prints it
a literal path saved directly
cases.script:
extends SceneTree

func _init() -> void:
	ResourceSaver.save(PackedScene.new(), "res://previews/bed_relief_preview.tscn")
	quit()

cases.name: a typed constant carried through a variable
cases.script:
const OUT: String = "res://previews/bed_relief_preview.tscn"

func run(scene: PackedScene) -> void:
	var target: String = OUT
	ResourceSaver.save(scene, target)

cases.name: a call spread over lines with a comment
cases.script:
# Writes res://previews/bed_relief_preview.tscn
const OUT := "res://previews/bed_relief_preview.tscn"

func run(scene: PackedScene) -> void:
	ResourceSaver.save(
		scene,
		OUT,
	)

cases.name: a file opened for writing
a removal through globalize_path
cases.script:
func clean() -> void:
	DirAccess.remove_absolute(ProjectSettings.globalize_path("res://previews/bed_relief_preview.tscn"))

cases.name: an image saved as png
a preload
cases.script: const Preview := preload("res://previews/bed_relief_preview.tscn")

cases.name: a load through a constant
a script that saves and loads it
a file opened for reading
a file opened for reading and writing
a path that is only printed
a constant nobody reads
cases.script: const OUT := "res://previews/bed_relief_preview.tscn"

cases.name: a path handed to the script's own function
a path built on
a constant that is reassigned
cases.script:
var out := "res://previews/bed_relief_preview.tscn"

func run(scene: PackedScene) -> void:
	ResourceSaver.save(scene, out)
	out = "res://other.tscn"

cases.name: a mention only in a comment
cases.script:
extends Node
# The preview lives at res://previews/bed_relief_preview.tscn

cases.name: a string with more than the path
cases.script:
func run() -> void:
	var scene := load("res://previews/bed_relief_preview.tscn::1")

cases.name: the arguments of Godot 3's save
cases.script:
func run(scene: PackedScene) -> void:
	ResourceSaver.save("res://previews/bed_relief_preview.tscn", scene)

cases.name: a path inside an array
a folder made with globalize_path
cases.script:
const OUT := "res://previews/bed_relief_preview.tscn"

func run(scene: PackedScene) -> void:
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(ProjectSettings.globalize_path(OUT.get_base_dir()))
	ResourceSaver.save(scene, OUT)

cases.name: a folder used for something else
a uid that is loaded
cases.script:
func run() -> void:
	var scene := load("uid://b8xpreview")
